description: P.P. Panditharathna v. K. Dharmasena and Another P.P. Panditharathna v. K. Dharmasena and Another View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: P.P. Panditharathna v. K. Dharmasena and Another P.P. Panditharathna v. K. Dharmasena and Another View More
keywords: Plaintiff claimed damages for injuries sustained in a road accident involving a private bus. District Court dismissed the action, finding that the plaintiff had negligently driven his motorcycle suddenly onto the main road, making the accident inevitable. Held - Court affirmed the District Court’s judgement, holding that the bus driver could not have averted the collision, constituting an inevitable accident; the plaintiff\'s own police statement contradicted his court evidence. Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
